description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Among the exiles by the Kebar Canal, Ezekiel sees a storm and four living creatures with wheels full of eyes, and above them a throne with the likeness of the glory of God.
1.sw: Kati ya watu walio uhamishoni kando ya mfereji wa Kebari, Ezekieli anaona dhoruba na viumbe hai wanne pamoja na magurudumu yaliyojaa macho, na juu yao kiti cha enzi chenye mfano wa utukufu wa Mungu.
1.am: ሕዝቅኤል በኮቦር ቦይ አጠገብ ካሉት ምርኮኞች መካከል ሆኖ ማዕበልንና በዓይኖች የተሞሉ መንኰራኵሮች ያሏቸውን አራት ሕያዋን ፍጡራን፣ ከእነርሱም በላይ የእግዚአብሔር ክብር አምሳያ ያለበትን ዙፋን ያያል።

2.en: God sends Ezekiel to the rebellious people of Israel, whether they listen or not, and gives him a scroll of lament and woe to eat.
2.sw: Mungu anamtuma Ezekieli kwa watu waasi wa Israeli, wakisikiliza au wasisikilize, na anampa gombo la maombolezo na ole ili alile.
2.am: እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቅኤልን ቢሰሙም ባይሰሙም ወደ ዓመፀኞቹ የእስራኤል ሕዝብ ይልከዋል፤ የሙሾና የወዮታ ጥቅልልም እንዲበላ ይሰጠዋል።

3.en: The scroll tastes as sweet as honey. God makes Ezekiel a watchman for Israel and tells him he will be silent except when God gives him words.
3.sw: Gombo hilo lina ladha tamu kama asali. Mungu anamfanya Ezekieli mlinzi wa Israeli na kumwambia atakuwa kimya isipokuwa Mungu anapompa maneno.
3.am: ጥቅልሉ እንደ ማር ይጣፍጣል። እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቅኤልን ለእስራኤል ጠባቂ ያደርገዋል፤ እግዚአብሔር ቃል ካልሰጠው በቀር ዝም እንደሚልም ይነግረዋል።

4.en: Ezekiel acts out the siege of Jerusalem with a brick and lies on his side for many days, eating rationed food as a sign.
4.sw: Ezekieli anaigiza kuzingirwa kwa Yerusalemu kwa tofali na kulala kwa ubavu wake kwa siku nyingi, akila chakula kilichopimwa kama ishara.
4.am: ሕዝቅኤል የኢየሩሳሌምን መከበብ በጡብ ያሳያል፤ ለብዙ ቀናትም በጎኑ ይተኛል፤ እንደ ምልክትም በልክ የተሰጠ ምግብ ይበላል።

5.en: Ezekiel shaves his head and divides the hair into thirds as a sign of what will happen to Jerusalem's people.
5.sw: Ezekieli ananyoa kichwa chake na kuzigawa nywele katika mafungu matatu kama ishara ya kile kitakachowapata watu wa Yerusalemu.
5.am: ሕዝቅኤል በኢየሩሳሌም ሕዝብ ላይ የሚደርሰውን ለማሳየት ራሱን ተላጭቶ ጠጕሩን በሦስት ይከፍላል።

6.en: Ezekiel prophesies against the mountains of Israel, where idols are worshiped; the altars will be destroyed, but a remnant will remember God.
6.sw: Ezekieli anatabiri dhidi ya milima ya Israeli, ambako sanamu zinaabudiwa; madhabahu yatabomolewa, lakini mabaki watamkumbuka Mungu.
6.am: ሕዝቅኤል ጣዖታት በሚመለኩባቸው በእስራኤል ተራሮች ላይ ትንቢት ይናገራል፤ መሠዊያዎቹ ይፈርሳሉ፤ ቅሬታው ግን እግዚአብሔርን ያስባሉ።

7.en: The end has come on the land, and God will judge Israel for its detestable practices.
7.sw: Mwisho umeifikia nchi, na Mungu atawahukumu Israeli kwa matendo yao ya kuchukiza.
7.am: ፍጻሜው በምድሪቱ ላይ መጥቷል፤ እግዚአብሔርም እስራኤልን ስለ አስጸያፊ ሥራቸው ይፈርድባቸዋል።

8.en: In a vision Ezekiel is taken to Jerusalem and sees idolatry in the temple: elders burning incense to images, women weeping for Tammuz and men worshiping the sun.
8.sw: Katika maono Ezekieli anachukuliwa mpaka Yerusalemu na kuona ibada ya sanamu hekaluni: wazee wakifukiza uvumba kwa sanamu, wanawake wakimlilia Tamuzi na wanaume wakiliabudu jua.
8.am: ሕዝቅኤል በራእይ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተወስዶ በቤተ መቅደሱ ውስጥ ጣዖት አምልኮን ያያል፦ ሽማግሌዎች ለምስሎች ዕጣን ሲያጥኑ፣ ሴቶች ለተሙዝ ሲያለቅሱ፣ ወንዶችም ለፀሐይ ሲሰግዱ።

9.en: Six executioners strike down the city's idolaters, but first a man in linen marks those who grieve over the city's sins.
9.sw: Wauaji sita wanawapiga waabudu sanamu wa mji, lakini kwanza mtu aliyevaa kitani anaweka alama juu ya wale wanaohuzunika kwa ajili ya dhambi za mji.
9.am: ስድስት ገዳዮች የከተማዪቱን ጣዖት አምላኪዎች ይመታሉ፤ አስቀድሞ ግን በፍታ የለበሰ ሰው ስለ ከተማዪቱ ኃጢአት በሚያዝኑት ላይ ምልክት ያደርጋል።

10.en: The glory of God rises from the cherubim and moves to the threshold of the temple.
10.sw: Utukufu wa Mungu unainuka kutoka kwa makerubi na kwenda kwenye kizingiti cha hekalu.
10.am: የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ከኪሩቤል ተነሥቶ ወደ ቤተ መቅደሱ መድረክ ይሄዳል።

11.en: God judges Jerusalem's leaders and promises to give the exiles a new heart and a new spirit. The glory of God leaves the city.
11.sw: Mungu anawahukumu viongozi wa Yerusalemu na kuahidi kuwapa walio uhamishoni moyo mpya na roho mpya. Utukufu wa Mungu unauacha mji.
11.am: እግዚአብሔር በኢየሩሳሌም መሪዎች ላይ ይፈርዳል፤ ለምርኮኞቹም አዲስ ልብና አዲስ መንፈስ እንደሚሰጣቸው ተስፋ ይሰጣል። የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ከከተማዪቱ ይወጣል።

12.en: Ezekiel packs his bags and digs through the wall as a sign of exile.
12.sw: Ezekieli anafunga mizigo yake na kutoboa ukuta kama ishara ya uhamisho.
12.am: ሕዝቅኤል ለስደት ምልክት ሆኖ ጓዙን ይጠቀልላል፤ ቅጥሩንም ይነድላል።

13.en: Ezekiel condemns the false prophets who say "Peace" when there is no peace, like those who whitewash a flimsy wall.
13.sw: Ezekieli anawahukumu manabii wa uongo wanaosema "Amani" wakati hakuna amani, kama wale wanaopaka chokaa ukuta dhaifu.
13.am: ሕዝቅኤል ሰላም ሳይኖር «ሰላም» የሚሉትን፣ ደካማ ግድግዳን በኖራ እንደሚለስኑ ያሉትን ሐሰተኛ ነቢያት ይወቅሳል።

14.en: God will not answer idolaters who come to inquire. Even Noah, Daniel and Job could save only themselves.
14.sw: Mungu hatawajibu waabudu sanamu wanaokuja kumwuliza. Hata Nuhu, Danieli na Ayubu wangeweza kujiokoa wao wenyewe tu.
14.am: እግዚአብሔር ሊጠይቁት ለሚመጡ ጣዖት አምላኪዎች አይመልስም። ኖኅ፣ ዳንኤልና ኢዮብ እንኳ ማዳን የሚችሉት ራሳቸውን ብቻ ነው።

15.en: Jerusalem is like a useless vine, fit only for burning.
15.sw: Yerusalemu ni kama mzabibu usiofaa, unaofaa tu kuchomwa.
15.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ለማቃጠል ብቻ እንደሚሆን የማይረባ የወይን ግንድ ናት።

16.en: God tells the story of Jerusalem as an abandoned baby whom God raised and married, who became unfaithful. Yet God will remember the covenant and make an everlasting covenant with her.
16.sw: Mungu anasimulia hadithi ya Yerusalemu kama mtoto mchanga aliyetupwa ambaye Mungu alimlea na kumwoa, aliyekuwa asiye mwaminifu. Lakini Mungu atalikumbuka agano na kufanya naye agano la milele.
16.am: እግዚአብሔር ኢየሩሳሌምን ያሳደጋትና ያገባት፣ ኋላ ግን ታማኝነቷን ያጐደለች የተጣለች ሕፃን አድርጎ ታሪኳን ይናገራል። ሆኖም እግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳኑን ያስባል፤ ከእርሷም ጋር የዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን ያደርጋል።

17.en: A parable of two eagles and a vine pictures the king of Judah's rebellion against Babylon. God will plant a tender shoot on a high mountain.
17.sw: Mfano wa tai wawili na mzabibu unaonyesha uasi wa mfalme wa Yuda dhidi ya Babeli. Mungu atapanda chipukizi changa juu ya mlima mrefu.
17.am: የሁለት ንስሮችና የወይን ግንድ ምሳሌ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ በባቢሎን ላይ ያደረገውን ዓመፅ ያሳያል። እግዚአብሔር በረጅም ተራራ ላይ ለጋ ቀንበጥ ይተክላል።

18.en: Each person is responsible for their own sin; the son will not die for the father's sin. God takes no pleasure in the death of the wicked and calls them to turn and live.
18.sw: Kila mtu anawajibika kwa dhambi yake mwenyewe; mwana hatakufa kwa sababu ya dhambi ya baba. Mungu hapendezwi na kifo cha mwovu na anawaita warudi waishi.
18.am: እያንዳንዱ ሰው ለራሱ ኃጢአት ተጠያቂ ነው፤ ልጅ ስለ አባቱ ኃጢአት አይሞትም። እግዚአብሔር በክፉው ሞት ደስ አይለውም፤ ተመልሰው በሕይወት እንዲኖሩም ይጠራቸዋል።

19.en: Ezekiel laments for Israel's princes, pictured as lion cubs captured and a vine uprooted.
19.sw: Ezekieli anaomboleza kwa ajili ya wakuu wa Israeli, wanaoonyeshwa kama wana-simba waliokamatwa na mzabibu uliong'olewa.
19.am: ሕዝቅኤል እንደ ተያዙ የአንበሳ ግልገሎችና እንደ ተነቀለ የወይን ግንድ ስለ ተሣሉት ስለ እስራኤል መኳንንት ሙሾ ያወርዳል።

20.en: God recounts Israel's rebellion since Egypt, yet promises to gather them and accept them on God's holy mountain.
20.sw: Mungu anasimulia uasi wa Israeli tangu Misri, lakini anaahidi kuwakusanya na kuwakubali juu ya mlima mtakatifu wa Mungu.
20.am: እግዚአብሔር ከግብፅ ጀምሮ የእስራኤልን ዓመፅ ይተርካል፤ ሆኖም እንደሚሰበስባቸውና በቅዱሱ ተራራው ላይ እንደሚቀበላቸው ተስፋ ይሰጣል።

21.en: God's sword is drawn against Jerusalem, and the king of Babylon chooses the road to the city.
21.sw: Upanga wa Mungu umefutwa dhidi ya Yerusalemu, na mfalme wa Babeli anachagua njia ya kwenda mjini.
21.am: የእግዚአብሔር ሰይፍ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ተመዟል፤ የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ወደ ከተማዪቱ የሚወስደውን መንገድ ይመርጣል።

22.en: Jerusalem is a city of bloodshed, and God will melt its people in a furnace. Its priests, prophets and princes have all failed.
22.sw: Yerusalemu ni mji wa umwagaji damu, na Mungu atawayeyusha watu wake katika tanuru. Makuhani wake, manabii wake na wakuu wake wote wameshindwa.
22.am: ኢየሩሳሌም የደም ከተማ ናት፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሕዝቧን በምድጃ ውስጥ ያቀልጣቸዋል። ካህናቷ፣ ነቢያቷና መኳንንቷ ሁሉ ወድቀዋል።

23.en: Two sisters, Oholah and Oholibah, picture Samaria and Jerusalem in their unfaithfulness, and they will be judged.
23.sw: Dada wawili, Ohola na Oholiba, wanaonyesha Samaria na Yerusalemu katika ukosefu wao wa uaminifu, nao watahukumiwa.
23.am: ሁለቱ እኅትማማቾች ኦሖላና ኦሖሊባ ሰማርያንና ኢየሩሳሌምን በታማኝነት ማጣታቸው ያሳያሉ፤ ይፈረድባቸዋልም።

24.en: A boiling pot pictures Jerusalem's siege. Ezekiel's wife dies, and he is told not to mourn, as a sign to the people.
24.sw: Chungu kinachochemka kinaonyesha kuzingirwa kwa Yerusalemu. Mke wa Ezekieli anakufa, naye anaambiwa asiomboleze, kama ishara kwa watu.
24.am: የሚፈላ ድስት የኢየሩሳሌምን መከበብ ያሳያል። የሕዝቅኤል ሚስት ትሞታለች፤ እርሱም ለሕዝቡ ምልክት ሆኖ እንዳያለቅስ ይነገረዋል።

25.en: Ezekiel prophesies against Ammon, Moab, Edom and the Philistines.
25.sw: Ezekieli anatabiri dhidi ya Waamoni, Moabu, Edomu na Wafilisti.
25.am: ሕዝቅኤል በአሞናውያን፣ በሞዓብ፣ በኤዶምና በፍልስጥኤማውያን ላይ ትንቢት ይናገራል።

26.en: Tyre will be destroyed by Nebuchadrezzar and never rebuilt.
26.sw: Tiro itaangamizwa na Nebukadreza na haitajengwa tena kamwe.
26.am: ጢሮስ በናቡከደነፆር ትጠፋለች፤ ዳግመኛም ከቶ አትሠራም።

27.en: Ezekiel laments for Tyre, pictured as a great ship that sinks in the sea.
27.sw: Ezekieli anaomboleza kwa ajili ya Tiro, inayoonyeshwa kama meli kubwa inayozama baharini.
27.am: ሕዝቅኤል በባሕር ውስጥ እንደምትሰጥም ታላቅ መርከብ ስለ ተሣለችው ስለ ጢሮስ ሙሾ ያወርዳል።

28.en: The king of Tyre, who claims to be a god, will be brought down. Sidon is judged, and Israel will be gathered and live in safety.
28.sw: Mfalme wa Tiro, anayedai kuwa mungu, atashushwa. Sidoni inahukumiwa, na Israeli watakusanywa na kuishi salama.
28.am: አምላክ ነኝ የሚለው የጢሮስ ንጉሥ ይዋረዳል። በሲዶና ላይ ይፈረዳል፤ እስራኤልም ተሰብስበው በደኅና ይኖራሉ።

29.en: Ezekiel prophesies against Pharaoh and Egypt, which will be laid waste.
29.sw: Ezekieli anatabiri dhidi ya Farao na Misri, itakayofanywa ukiwa.
29.am: ሕዝቅኤል ባድማ በምትሆነው በግብፅና በፈርዖን ላይ ትንቢት ይናገራል።

30.en: Egypt's day of doom is near, and Babylon will strike it.
30.sw: Siku ya maangamizi ya Misri iko karibu, na Babeli itaipiga.
30.am: የግብፅ የጥፋት ቀን ቀርቧል፤ ባቢሎንም ትመታታለች።

31.en: Egypt is compared to a great cedar that will be cut down, as Assyria was.
31.sw: Misri inalinganishwa na mwerezi mkubwa utakaokatwa, kama Ashuru ilivyokatwa.
31.am: ግብፅ እንደ አሦር ከሚቈረጥ ታላቅ ዝግባ ጋር ትነጻጸራለች።

32.en: Ezekiel laments for Pharaoh, who will go down to the grave with the uncircumcised.
32.sw: Ezekieli anaomboleza kwa ajili ya Farao, atakayeshuka Kuzimu pamoja na wasiotahiriwa.
32.am: ሕዝቅኤል ካልተገረዙት ጋር ወደ ሙታን ዓለም ስለሚወርደው ስለ ፈርዖን ሙሾ ያወርዳል።

33.en: God makes Ezekiel a watchman again and calls the wicked to turn and live. News comes that Jerusalem has fallen.
33.sw: Mungu anamfanya Ezekieli mlinzi tena na kuwaita waovu warudi waishi. Habari zinafika kwamba Yerusalemu imeanguka.
33.am: እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቅኤልን ዳግመኛ ጠባቂ ያደርገዋል፤ ክፉዎችንም ተመልሰው በሕይወት እንዲኖሩ ይጠራቸዋል። ኢየሩሳሌም እንደ ወደቀች ወሬ ይደርሳል።

34.en: God condemns the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves, and promises to shepherd the flock and set David over them.
34.sw: Mungu anawahukumu wachungaji wa Israeli wanaojilisha wenyewe, na anaahidi kulichunga kundi na kumweka Daudi juu yao.
34.am: እግዚአብሔር ራሳቸውን የሚመግቡትን የእስራኤል እረኞች ይፈርድባቸዋል፤ መንጋውን ራሱ እንደሚጠብቅና ዳዊትን በላያቸው እንደሚሾም ተስፋ ይሰጣል።

35.en: God will judge Mount Seir, Edom, for its hostility toward Israel.
35.sw: Mungu atauhukumu Mlima Seiri, yaani Edomu, kwa uadui wake dhidi ya Israeli.
35.am: እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ላይ ስላለው ጠላትነት የሴይርን ተራራ፣ ኤዶምን ይፈርድበታል።

36.en: The mountains of Israel will be fruitful again. God will give the people a new heart and a new spirit for the sake of God's holy name.
36.sw: Milima ya Israeli itazaa matunda tena. Mungu atawapa watu moyo mpya na roho mpya kwa ajili ya jina takatifu la Mungu.
36.am: የእስራኤል ተራሮች ዳግመኛ ፍሬ ያፈራሉ። እግዚአብሔር ስለ ቅዱስ ስሙ ለሕዝቡ አዲስ ልብና አዲስ መንፈስ ይሰጣቸዋል።

37.en: In the valley of dry bones God tells Ezekiel to prophesy, and the bones come together and live. Two sticks joined together picture Judah and Israel united under one king.
37.sw: Katika bonde la mifupa mikavu Mungu anamwambia Ezekieli atabiri, na mifupa inaungana na kuwa hai. Vijiti viwili vilivyounganishwa vinaonyesha Yuda na Israeli wakiunganishwa chini ya mfalme mmoja.
37.am: በደረቅ አጥንቶች ሸለቆ እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቅኤልን ትንቢት እንዲናገር ይነግረዋል፤ አጥንቶቹም ተገጣጥመው ሕያው ይሆናሉ። የተያያዙ ሁለት በትሮች ይሁዳና እስራኤል በአንድ ንጉሥ ሥር እንደሚዋሐዱ ያሳያሉ።

38.en: Gog of the land of Magog will attack the restored Israel, but God will defeat him.
38.sw: Gogu wa nchi ya Magogu atawashambulia Israeli waliorejeshwa, lakini Mungu atamshinda.
38.am: የማጎግ ምድር ጎግ በታደሰችው እስራኤል ላይ አደጋ ይጥላል፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ድል ያደርገዋል።

39.en: Gog's armies fall, and Israel spends months burying the dead. God will pour out the Spirit on Israel.
39.sw: Majeshi ya Gogu yanaanguka, na Israeli wanatumia miezi kuwazika wafu. Mungu atamwaga Roho juu ya Israeli.
39.am: የጎግ ሠራዊት ይወድቃል፤ እስራኤልም ሙታንን በመቅበር ወራት ያሳልፋሉ። እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ላይ መንፈሱን ያፈስሳል።

40.en: In a vision Ezekiel is taken to a high mountain and sees a man with a measuring rod measuring a new temple.
40.sw: Katika maono Ezekieli anachukuliwa mpaka mlima mrefu na kuona mtu mwenye mwanzi wa kupimia akipima hekalu jipya.
40.am: ሕዝቅኤል በራእይ ወደ ረጅም ተራራ ተወስዶ መለኪያ ዘንግ የያዘ ሰው አዲስ ቤተ መቅደስ ሲለካ ያያል።

41.en: The man measures the temple's inner rooms and decorations.
41.sw: Mtu huyo anapima vyumba vya ndani vya hekalu na mapambo yake.
41.am: ሰውየው የቤተ መቅደሱን ውስጣዊ ክፍሎችና ጌጦቹን ይለካል።

42.en: The man measures the priests' rooms and the outer wall.
42.sw: Mtu huyo anapima vyumba vya makuhani na ukuta wa nje.
42.am: ሰውየው የካህናቱን ክፍሎችና የውጭውን ቅጥር ይለካል።

43.en: The glory of God returns to the temple from the east and fills it, and the altar is dedicated.
43.sw: Utukufu wa Mungu unarudi hekaluni kutoka mashariki na kulijaza, na madhabahu yanawekwa wakfu.
43.am: የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ከምሥራቅ ወደ ቤተ መቅደሱ ተመልሶ ይሞላዋል፤ መሠዊያውም ይቀደሳል።

44.en: The east gate is closed for God has entered through it. Only the Levites of Zadok's line may serve as priests.
44.sw: Lango la mashariki linafungwa kwa kuwa Mungu ameingia kupitia hilo. Walawi wa ukoo wa Sadoki peke yao ndio wanaoweza kutumika kama makuhani.
44.am: እግዚአብሔር በእርሱ ስለ ገባ የምሥራቁ በር ይዘጋል። ካህናት ሆነው ማገልገል የሚችሉት ከሳዶቅ ዘር የሆኑ ሌዋውያን ብቻ ናቸው።

45.en: A portion of land is set apart for God, the priests, the city and the prince, and offerings and festivals are ordered.
45.sw: Sehemu ya ardhi inatengwa kwa ajili ya Mungu, makuhani, mji na mkuu, na sadaka na sikukuu zinaagizwa.
45.am: ለእግዚአብሔር፣ ለካህናቱ፣ ለከተማዪቱና ለገዥው የመሬት ድርሻ ይለያል፤ መባዎችና በዓላትም ይታዘዛሉ።

46.en: The prince and the people worship at the appointed times, and rules are given for the prince's property.
46.sw: Mkuu na watu wanaabudu katika nyakati zilizoamriwa, na kanuni zinatolewa kuhusu mali ya mkuu.
46.am: ገዥውና ሕዝቡ በተወሰኑት ጊዜያት ይሰግዳሉ፤ ስለ ገዥውም ንብረት ሥርዓት ይሰጣል።

47.en: A river flows from the temple, growing deeper and bringing life wherever it goes. The borders of the land are set.
47.sw: Mto unatiririka kutoka hekaluni, ukizidi kuwa na kina na kuleta uhai kila mahali unapopita. Mipaka ya nchi inawekwa.
47.am: ከቤተ መቅደሱ ወንዝ ይፈስሳል፤ እየጠለቀ ይሄዳል፤ በሚደርስበትም ሁሉ ሕይወትን ያመጣል። የምድሪቱ ወሰኖች ይወሰናሉ።

48.en: The land is divided among the tribes, and the city will be named for God's presence there.
48.sw: Nchi inagawanywa kati ya makabila, na mji utaitwa kwa jina linalotaja kuwepo kwa Mungu huko.
48.am: ምድሪቱ ለነገዶቹ ትከፋፈላለች፤ ከተማዪቱም እግዚአብሔር በዚያ መኖሩን በሚገልጽ ስም ትጠራለች።
